msg: Hi, I'm Advanced Open Water certified, from London. I'm staying at a hotel on Isla Grande for 5 days. I'd like the 4-dive package over 2 days. How much and how do I book?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

The 4-dive package includes four daytime dives over two days. Lunch isn’t included, and accommodation is booked directly with your hotel.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 204 USD · 227 USD
• Fun Dives - 1 dive (1 day): 97 USD · 108 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD

I don’t have the booking link for this package handy.

From the islands we coordinate pick-up and drop-off at your hotel if it has maritime access, or at the nearest dock we point you to.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to help you book?

msg: Great, I'll take the 4-dive package for next Tuesday and Wednesday, just me. I'm at Hotel Isla del Encanto. How do I pay?
reply:
For the 4-dive package over two days, the online price is 204 USD per person; the regular price is 227 USD. Lunch isn’t included.

International clients pay 100% by card through the online booking link. Payment is recorded right away, and the team reconciles it shortly after to confirm the booking. If the online payment fails, the team can send a bank-transfer payment link, and the 10% online discount is kept. Otherwise, payment by transfer isn’t available. With a foreign card, use your passport as the ID document.

I don’t have the booking link for this package here, so a team advisor will need to help with the booking.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Has it been *more than 2 years* since your last dive?
